label: VERIFIED
extraction: Agent Team Work Zone provides persistent workspace for long-lived Claude Code agent teams. Treats each agent as human employee with durable 'workstation' directory containing state, skills, hooks, scripts. Agents stay ephemeral but reconstitution needs written to disk. Uses <slug>-<role> naming (e.g., architect-typesetter) for teammate identification; idle hook derives workstation path from slug prefix. Workspace layout: framework-owned (resources/, docs/, skills/, agents/, scripts/, hooks/) and user-owned paths (projects/, workstations/). Includes journal-based tracking, SKILL.md skill framework, versioning via bootstrap scripts. Key insight: persistence layer enables continuity, recoverability, audit trail without modifying Claude Code agents. Integrates with Claude Code Agent Teams experimental feature for peer-to-peer messaging and shared task lists.
